manifest.description: Keep a markdown notebook that lives in a git repository, so your notes are versioned, portable, and readable by any other editor. Point it at a GitHub repo and it clones a working copy, or attach a folder you already have — including an existing Obsidian vault — and it adopts that checkout in place without making a second copy. Notes render as formatted text you can click straight into to edit, [[wikilinks]] connect them, and every note shows what links back to it. Sync commits, pulls and pushes in one step, and a merge conflict is reported — listing the conflicted notes and aborting the merge — rather than overwriting anything.
manifest.highlight_1: Your notes are plain markdown in a git repo — no lock-in, readable by Obsidian or any editor
manifest.highlight_2: Clone a GitHub repo as a vault, or attach a folder you already have without copying it
manifest.highlight_3: Click any rendered block to edit it in place; Enter starts a new block, Tab nests lists
manifest.highlight_4: [[Wikilinks]] between notes, with a backlinks list showing what points at the note you are reading
manifest.highlight_5: Full-text search across titles and content, plus folder and flat views with six sort orders
manifest.highlight_6: One-step sync commits, pulls and pushes; a merge conflict lists the conflicted notes and overwrites nothing
manifest.highlight_7: A save is refused if the file changed on disk since you opened it, so edits made elsewhere are never clobbered
manifest.highlight_8: Optionally index a vault into the Knowledge library so agents can search your notes
manifest.use_case_1: Edit a portable Markdown vault with wikilinks, backlinks, search, Git history, and optional Knowledge indexing.
manifest.configuration_1: Clone a Git repository or attach an existing local folder, then optionally enable Knowledge and scheduled sync; private GitHub clones need a PAT or authenticated gh.
